name: Rupesh Tiwari
title: AWS Senior Customer Solutions Manager | ISB CTO Scholar
tagline: SDE to Solutions Architect to AWS Leader. I've walked the path you're on.
story: I started as a Software Engineer, writing code and shipping products. Then I became a Solutions Architect, designing large-scale distributed systems for Fortune 500 clients. In 2021, I joined AWS as a Global Senior Solutions Architect, then rose to Senior Customer Solutions Manager working with Salesforce, Intuit, and other enterprise giants on $100M+ digital transformations.
I've been on both sides of the FAANG interview table. I know what bar raisers look for. I understand why brilliant technologists fail Director/VP interviews and more importantly, how to fix it.

Since 2010, I've coached 4,000+ professionals from Senior Engineers to VPs. My 5.0 rating on IGotAnOffer isn't luck. It's the result of 15+ years understanding the entire tech career ladder and knowing exactly how to position YOUR experience for the next level.
